name: United Arab Emirates University
englishBachelors: About 60 bachelor's programmes across nine colleges. Study plans for engineering, computing and business are in English; Law needs an Arabic test and Arabic-language degrees are taught in Arabic. Check each programme's language.
note: A federal university in the oasis city of Al Ain. International students are admitted competitively, but the Doctor of Medicine and Veterinary Medicine are restricted, and UAE nationals have their own admission route and funding.
summary: Federal research university in Al Ain with nine colleges and about 60 bachelor's programmes; international students are admitted competitively on school averages, and the MD and veterinary degrees are restricted.
about: UAEU is a federal university where admission is competitive and meeting the minimum does not guarantee a place. International students apply with a school average of 85-90% or equivalent, plus Maths and science for technical colleges.

ib.text: No IB points minimum is published. Entry sets school-average minima (85-90% or equivalent); IB HL Maths 5 for engineering, computing, science and health, 4 for business and agriculture.

noDeadline: Announced application periods only; no 2027 dates found
notes: IB: the international-student page names no IB Diploma points total and gives no IB-to-percentage conversion. Each college asks for a high-school average of 85% or 90% or its equivalent, so ask UAEU how an IB Diploma is converted. It lists IB Higher Level Maths at 5 for Engineering, Computing and AI, Science and Medicine/Health programmes, and at 4 for Business and Economics, Law and Agriculture.

Science subjects: Engineering needs Physics plus Chemistry or Biology at HL 5; Computing needs Physics or Computer Science at HL 5; Science needs one of Biology, Chemistry or Physics at HL 5; Medicine and Health Sciences needs one science at HL 5; Agriculture needs Chemistry or Biology at HL 4. IB Course Results are not described.

Restricted degrees: the Doctor of Medicine admits UAE nationals, children of Emirati mothers and students with funding for the full tuition. Veterinary Medicine admits mainly UAE nationals; international students only with a scholarship, a high academic standard and Dean approval.

English proof: 90% in school English, or IELTS Academic 5.5, TOEFL iBT 70 or TOEFL ITP 525. IELTS Indicator, TOEFL Home Edition, Duolingo and TOEFL ITP taken outside the UAE are not accepted. Native speakers who completed secondary school in an English-medium school in an English-speaking country, or UAE private-school students taught in English, may be exempt. Whether an IB English grade counts is not stated.

General rules: apply in the announced application periods; hold a Grade 12 certificate (UAE Ministry of Education equivalency needed for non-MOE schools); applicants must be 35 or younger; admission priority goes to higher results and more recent graduation. Admission fee: AED 210 for all degrees (Student Accounts FAQ).

Dates: no undergraduate application dates for 2027 entry were published on the pages checked; the only deadlines found are graduate (2026/27) and 2026 fee-payment dates. Ask admissions for the open periods.

Tuition: the 2027/28 fee table for undergraduate programmes could not be retrieved; the Student Accounts page points to a rates table that did not load. Fees are therefore not stated here. The university reserves the right to change fees without notice.

Scholarships: from 2025/26 international students and children of staff can receive tuition discounts. The Chancellor's Scholarship gives a full tuition waiver for 98%+ or equivalent plus TOEFL iBT 105 or IELTS 7.5 and SAT Maths 730 (or ACT 32) for most colleges, with a 75% waiver from 95%. Apply with the admission application; the Maths proof listed is an SAT or ACT score, not an IB grade.

Teaching language: no sentence on language of instruction was found. Because English tests are required and study plans for the programmes checked are in English, many degrees appear English-taught, but verify the programme before applying.
